sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports the pop-up building blocks
sections.what: Brings in the icons, the goal type, the AI helper, the store and the shared button that the pop-up uses.
sections.why: Likely reason: these are the pieces needed to read the goal, ask the AI for suggestions and save tasks. The first line marks the file as browser-side code, likely because it uses interactive features.

sections.name: AIGoalBreakdownModalProps
sections.title: Pop-up input settings
sections.what: Defines the three values the pop-up receives: the goal, whether the pop-up is open, and a function that closes it.
sections.why: Likely reason: lets the parent screen control when the pop-up appears and which goal it shows.
sections.watch_out: If no goal is given, the pop-up shows nothing at all.

sections.name: AIGoalBreakdownModal (part 1)
sections.title: Loads AI task suggestions on open
sections.what: When the pop-up opens with a goal, it asks the AI helper to split the goal into tasks and shows a loading state while waiting. Successful suggestions are kept on screen, and a failed request leaves the list empty.
sections.why: Likely reason: loads suggestions automatically so they are ready to review. Reason for clearing the list on failure not stated in the code.
sections.watch_out: The loading flag is set but never displayed, and a failed request looks the same as having no suggestions.

sections.name: AIGoalBreakdownModal (part 2)
sections.title: Lists suggestions and adds all tasks
sections.what: Shows each suggested task with its time estimate. The Add All button creates one real task per suggestion and then closes the pop-up. Cancel closes it without adding anything.
sections.why: Likely reason: lets the user approve the whole plan with one click. Reason not stated in the code.
sections.watch_out: The button text is fixed at 3 tasks, so it will be wrong if the AI returns a different number.

summary: A pop-up that asks the AI helper to split one goal into tasks, lets the user review them, and adds them all to the workspace in one click.
purpose: Turns a big goal into a short list of actionable tasks the user can approve.
why: Likely reason: the suggestions are shown first, so the user can review them before anything is added to the workspace.
how: When the pop-up opens with a goal, it asks the AI helper for task suggestions and shows a loading state. The suggestions appear as a list. Add All creates one task per suggestion, tagged with the AI-Breakdown label and the goal's category, then closes. Cancel or the close button closes without adding anything.
inputs: A goal, an open or closed flag, and a close function from the parent screen. The suggestion list from the AI helper, where each item has a title, a time estimate and a priority.
outputs: New tasks added to the store through addTask, with status todo, high energy and no subtasks. Nothing is saved if the user cancels.
risks: If the AI call fails, the list is silently empty and nothing tells the user. The button text says 3 tasks even when the list has a different number. Priority is loosely typed, so an unexpected value can be saved.
debug: If the list stays empty, check breakdownGoalIntoTasks in the aiAssistantEngine file and whether it returns an error. If tasks have wrong priority or time, check the suggestions it returns. If old suggestions show for a new goal, check that the goal value changes when the user opens a different goal.
